results.title: Can Nepal cook dal bhat on its own electricity?
results.content: Nepal spends tens of billions of rupees a year on cooking gas. A 10-year electric-cooking mission could cut the bill, starting with households, hotels and the grid.

results.title: Three in four transport jobs in Nepal are informal
results.content: ILO study calls for stronger labour protections, affordable social security contributions, and a legal framework to protect ride-hailing and delivery workers.

results.title: Nepal launches TikTok campaign to promote tourism to global audiences
results.content: The campaign, running until the end of 2026, aims to showcase Nepal’s natural beauty, cultural heritage and diverse tourism experiences through digital storytelling and international content creators.

results.title: Nepal’s game developers seek tax relief, Google access to scale globally
results.content: Industry leaders say high taxes and restrictions on Google Play merchant accounts are stifling local developers, as the prime minister pledges to create conditions for a home-grown technology unicorn.

results.title: Nepal’s share market weathers political jitters
results.content: Rumours of a possible arrest of a top politician, business figures in custody, and the Tihar festive season rattled investors, but technical indicators suggest the market is regaining some stability.

results.title: Nepal’s peak electricity demand hits 1,813MW on Laxmi Puja evening
results.content: The country exported 587.3MW of surplus power to India, while electricity supply remained uninterrupted nationwide during peak hours.

results.title: Nepal expects peak electricity demand to reach 1,700MW on Laxmi Puja
results.content: The Nepal Electricity Authority says domestic generation will be sufficient to meet demand during Tihar, with industries expected to remain closed and power exports continuing.

results.title: Nepal clinch U-19 women’s cricket title unbeaten in China
results.content: The four-team Belt and Road Series saw Nepal win four of their six matches, with the remaining two abandoned due to rain.

results.title: How Nepali artists are celebrating Tihar
results.content: From buying silverware and festive essentials to writing screenplays and mourning loved ones, Nepali artists have different ways of marking—or sitting out—Tihar.

results.title: Jijivisha stitched Everest onto a red-carpet suit. Nothing came from Paris, Milan or New York.
results.content: Designer Shavona Shrestha’s clothing label made an ivory silk suit for Thinley Lhamo to wear at the premiere of ‘Tenzing’, using Nepali silk, stones and artisans. It is the label’s boldest argument yet for Nepali couture.

results.title: From flood-hit areas to crime scenes, Nepal’s police dogs sniff out vital clues
results.content: One of 107 dogs in the police force, Leo located two bodies and human remains during a 20-day search after the Bhotekoshi floods.

results.title: Nepal’s 250-year-old foreign policy still works. Why does no one use it?
results.content: Nepal has drifted between Delhi and Beijing for three decades. The Shah government has the mandate to stop it.

results.title: The families who wait
results.content: Remittances keep Nepal’s economy afloat. The people left behind carry a cost that rarely appears in figures.

results.title: Your guide to this week’s cultural events in Kathmandu Valley
results.content: The Post rounds up the week’s cultural highlights, from festive celebrations and heritage events to live music and dance across the Valley.

results.title: David Warner lifts TU as Kathmandu hand Lumbini their first defeat of the season
results.content: The Australian icon smashes 66 off 50 to set up a decisive victory over the defending champions in front of a packed crowd at TU Stadium.

results.title: Building trust and confidence a must before going to India with a wish list, experts advise Nepali leadership
results.content: With Prime Minister Shah prepared to visit New Delhi after two weeks, a former Indian diplomat says the mood in the Indian capital is positive.

results.title: Kathmandu end Lumbini’s unbeaten run with 36-run win
results.content: David Warner and Sahil Patel put on a century stand as Kathmandu secure their third consecutive victory and move to second in the NPL standings.

results.title: Warner, Sahil Patel put on century stand as Kathmandu set Lumbini 161-run target
results.content: Warner scores 66 and Patel makes 38 in a 104-run opening partnership before Kathmandu finish on 160-8 in 20 overs.

results.title: Australian PM Albanese dons Dhaka topi to celebrate Nepal Festival in Sydney

results.title: Kathmandu look to break into top three against leaders Lumbini
results.content: Lumbini aim to consolidate their lead, while Kathmandu can climb to third with a win in Saturday’s 5 pm match.

results.title: UN expert urges Nepal to revive stalled transitional justice process
results.content: With the 20th anniversary of the Comprehensive Peace Accord approaching, Bernard Duhaime calls for swift appointments to the two commissions and renewed efforts to deliver justice to conflict victims.
